name: blackswan-roll
description: The commodity index-ROLL ('Goldman roll') probe — the first NON-CRYPTO, non-price-derived probe, and the first to pass the counterparty test with a genuinely NAMED price-insensitive forced flow. Passive long-only commodity-index funds (S&P GSCI, Bloomberg BCOM) mechanically roll their front-month longs into the next contract on a FIXED, PUBLISHED schedule (GSCI = business days 5-9 each month), price-INSENSITIVELY and fully TELEGRAPHED — the over-paying counterparty that structurally cannot stop, the one thing 'model Apple and predict its price' lacks. The trade is a MARKET-NEUTRAL WTI M1-M2 calendar spread held across the roll window: roll_frontrun SHORTS the spread into the roll (Mou 2011's direction — anticipating the index selling nearby / buying deferred), roll_fade LONGS it (betting the effect over-arbitraged and reversed). Because it is delta-neutral there is NO buy-and-hold benchmark and the exposure-bias trap that dogged majority-beats-hold does not apply; the honest decider is the strategy's own per-trade Sharpe, DSR-deflated for the sweep (objective = oos_sharpe). Reuses the trainer summary primitives so every gate/DSR aggregation reads a roll cell unchanged. Leakage traps pinned in test_roll.py: the spread is built from RAW per-contract settlements (M1 and M2 of the actual contracts), NEVER a back-adjusted continuous series (a continuous roll bakes the effect in — a look-ahead machine); a month missing either leg on its entry/exit day is DROPPED, never forward-filled; entry business-day < exit business-day is enforced; each month's return reads ONLY its own entry+exit settlements. PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION: reproduce Mou in roll-2006-2011, refute-via-decay in roll-2016-2025 (post-publication crowding + diversified/dynamic-roll indices) — a §D reproduce-and-refute artifact either way. Deterministic and model-free (the seed is contract-only). DATA: WTI contract settlements M1..M4 daily from EIA (RCLC1..RCLC4), mined to eia-wti/<asset>.json by scripts/fetch_wti.py (needs a free EIA_API_KEY).

asset.description: Which commodity's front/second futures settlements drive the calendar spread. WTI = the single largest energy weight in the S&P GSCI, so the passive-index roll flow is largest and most detectable; HO/RB/NG/ags are follow-ups only if WTI survives.

signal.description: roll_frontrun SHORTS the M1-M2 spread into the roll (Mou's direction: the index sells nearby / buys deferred, so the nearby cheapens); roll_fade LONGS it (the mirror control — the effect over-arbitraged and reversed). Pre-registering both prevents post-hoc direction cherry-picking. An unknown value is refused.

entry_bday.description: The business day of the month (1 = first trading date) at whose settlement the spread is ENTERED — before the GSCI day-5 roll start. Business day k = the k-th trading date present in the settlement data (weekends/holidays are absent by construction), so the roll calendar is deterministic and known ahead.

exit_bday.description: The business day of the month at whose settlement the spread is EXITED — at/after the GSCI day-9 roll end. Must exceed entry_bday (a spread cannot be entered after it is exited); a month with fewer trading days than exit_bday is not traded.

roll_schedule.description: Descriptive label for the index roll window the entry/exit days straddle (GSCI = business days 5-9). The entry_bday/exit_bday levers are the actual computation; this records which index's telegraphed schedule is being front-run.

transaction_cost.description: Per-leg fee, charged on BOTH contracts (M1 and M2) at entry and again at exit (four leg-transactions per round trip). WTI calendar spreads are very liquid, so this is a fraction of a percent; even so the per-trade edge must clear it.

walk_forward_window.description: Which span is ACCOUNTED (the roll strategy is a fixed rule with no training leg). roll-2006-2011 reproduces Mou's documented era; roll-2016-2025 is the post-publication out-of-sample. A real edge must clear the DSR-deflated Sharpe in BOTH; the pre-registered base case is in-sample-only (reproduce then decay).

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the backtest is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept (identical cells would fake replication).
